name: architecture-validation
description: Validates architectural constraints (ArchUnit rules) when Gradle build files or module structure changes, ensuring hexagonal architecture compliance

validationAction.description: Run ArchUnit tests to validate no dependency cycles, domain isolation from infrastructure/presentation, and correct module layering.
validationAction.failureMessage: Architecture validation failed. Check that domain does not import infrastructure/presentation, no cyclic dependencies exist between modules, and layering rules are respected.
